Marta (CS): Quick capture from today's call with Meridian Health  they surfaced a couple of export-related blockers that could delay renewal.
Owen (CS): Top asks: 1) export filtering by facility + status, 2) guarantee exports <90s for hourly runs, 3) include stable row IDs to prevent duplicates on retries.
Liam (Support): We saw duplicates when their ingestion retried; ticket S-4333 has traces. Not huge numbers but auditors flagged it.
Sana (Onboarding): Meridian said their hourly run is ~4k rows and they need the output within the 15-minute compliance window. Quote: "If exports miss the window, auditors stop the test."
Priya (PM): Quick scoring proposal: Impact H/M/L, Effort S/M/L, RenewalRisk Y/N. Also need exact schema and sample payload sizes.
Marta (CS): CS vote: filtered exports = H / M / Y; export SLA <90s = H / M / Y; stable row IDs = M / S / Y.
Priya (PM): I'll open two tickets: RDW-4705 (exports: filtering + perf spike) and RDW-4706 (export row-id + dedupe guidance). Will run a 48h spike to test streaming + partitioned queries.
Liam (Support): I'll attach S-4333 logs to RDW-4706 and include examples of duplicate IDs.
Sana (Onboarding): I'll request Meridian's largest export sample and confirm which fields they use for dedupe.
redwoodbot: Reminder: include customer reference and onboarding notes when filing tickets.
Marta (CS): Action items: 1) Sana collect sample & schema, 2) Priya create tickets + run spike, 3) Liam attach logs, 4) Owen flag renewal-risk in tracker.
Priya (PM): Spike starts Monday; expect PoC + perf numbers by Wednesday EOD. Will update this thread with RDW numbers when created.
Marta (CS): Scheduling a short sync Friday 9:00 to share outcomes and message Meridian. :calendar: 
Owen (CS): Closing loop for now  will mark these items in the feedback tracker and tag renewal risk. :white_check_mark:
